option.mode.1.help: Each player completes their own objectives. The player with the most points wins.
option.mode.2.help: Together, without communicating, complete all the visible objectives before a tile pile runs out.
option.quadriCards.help: At the start of the game, each player chooses to play with the Quadri Kids Objective cards or with the harder 4 and 5 point cards from the Quadri game: ideal to balance a game between parents and children.
